You control a bat, which must 'serve' the ball into play, and then follow it through the level, deflecting it before it falls behind you, as this costs you one of your 4 lives. Initially the obstacles are all static, but moving barriers add timing, reactions and luck to proceedings.

There are also several bonus objects, which are collected by passing through them. These include an L for an extra ball and dual rectangles to give you a second bat which moves around at random.

The game also comes with a full level editor, allowing you to design new levels and save them to tape or disk.

124330.overview:
Young Simba just can't wait to be king. His father is the current King of the Savannah and the young prince is able to frolic the lands at will; jumping on and around other subjects of this animal kingdom. When Simba's father, King Mufasa, is killed and his evil brother Scar takes over the kingdom, Simba is banished from the lands of his birthright and has to grow up fast, honing his skills, for the day of his return.

The Lion King, based on the famous Disney movie, is a platform game where you control Simba - initially as a young cub, and later as an adult lion. The plot of the game follows the plot of the movie. Each of the levels represents a part of the movie. 

As young Simba, you can fight various beasts, such as lizards, by jumping on them. You can also roar to scare some creatures into submission, though every time you roar, you have to wait for your "roar meter" to charge. 

As an adult lion, you can still roar and jump, but now you fight enemies by slashing at them with your claws (if you're skillful enough, you can also grab them and toss them off the screen). 

The game features no in-game save function, and it needs to be replayed from the beginning every time.

124423.overview:
Sweet she is and sweets she wants. Young Lolly wakes up and has an incredibly appetite for candy. For chocolate, and for caramel and gingerbread, and for cookies and crisps and marshmallows and lemonade and bubblegum and jelly bears and ice and cream and sugar frosted chocolate bombs. All right, we’ve all had such moments. But Lolly is a doll. Animated by a stroke of lightning, she suddenly has life, a sweet tooth and a quest: Onward to the land where candy grows and the refrigerators never run out!

It’s a hostile world for small, innocent and rather hungry little dolls – that’s why you’ve got to help Lolly find her way through eight big levels in this jump’n’run game. After the escape from the toy factory, the way to the promised land leads through places like a ghost town, a snow world and even Lolly’s own cottony dreams. The way is far from safe: plenty of traps and monsters threaten a doll’s life, but good timing, athletic leaps and an ample supply of lollipops to fling at obtrusive enemies help mastering any challenge. In desperate situations, Lolly can take a snapshot with her pocket camera, which instantly destroys all opponents on the screen. Huge level bosses guard the exit of each world; defeating the mega-monsters requires specific tactics. 

Fortunately, there is support: chests contain key items (to unlock different parts of each level), power-ups and plenty of sweets, of course. On the downside, the boxes may also yield harmful objects that jumble up Lolly’s controls or even hurt her. Tender dolls of that model can sustain three hits before they break apart. There’s a time limit for each level, so sucking popsicles in a corner won’t do. You cannot save the game, but you get a personal passcode after each level.

124424.overview: This is a driving simulation is which you get to drive all the stages in the Lombard RAC rally. The game includes day and night stages, along with different weather conditions such as fog and snow. There is also a workshop option where you can repair and tweak your car to get a bit of extra speed. The game's main innovation is that the screen display is from behind the front seats - you can see the driver adjusting the steering wheel and gearstick, and the co-driver holds a map which changes colour as the track is covered.

124425.overview:
Turn-based strategy game based on Julian Gollop's earlier games, Chaos and Laser Squad. The setting is pure fantasy — the Old World is wrecked by magical discharges, and the wizards who attempted to keep it balanced ultimately gave up, and used their skill to create a new world. These Lords of Chaos (up to four, played either by human or computer) may now battle for control of this world.

The idea of the game is to escape the level within a certain number of moves (preferably carrying lot of treasure and having killed the evil wizard Torquemada). Along the way you can use wizardry weapons and spells (there are 45 in total, created by combining ingredients) to conjure up mystical creatures like dragons and unicorns, but unfortunately so can Torquemada. Worlds include marshlands, castles and forests.

124426.overview:
The English throne lies empty in 1268 A.D. You and 5 lords are locked in a struggle for the crown. Reap the benefits of successful feudal governing, castle-building, castle-sieging, and land battle to conquer your rivals and claim the kingdom.

You must keep your serfs fed and happy. Then assign them to farming, herding, building, military and other tasks. Design your own castles or build them using actual historical blueprints. Then lay siege to your neighbors' castles and fight out land battles in tactical detail.

124634.overview:
The Amiga version of the game was ported by the French developer Microïds. They only released the game in French (L'Art de la Guerre) and Spain (El Arte de la Guerra).

L'Art de la Guerre is a real-time strategy game based on the very basic elements of war: unit types, formation, and strength. The game is set in ancient battle-style times before the use of gun powder, consisting of the three basic unit types of that period: the light armored but fast 'barbarians', the heavily armored but slow 'knights', and the ranged 'archers'. A fourth non-combatant unit type is also available: 'spies', which is only available under certain campaign rule settings. 

The game consists of different scenarios to choose from, each with a different geographical setting, difficulty setting, visibility setting, and victory condition setting. Some settings may be subject to change by the player.

Gameplay is represented in two major areas:
The first is the tactical/political map, which visualizes geographical and terrain elements from a top-down perspective. Here the player can coordinate, position, reinforce troops, and also command them to attack, defend or ambush enemy troops in a real-time setting. Time may be set to pause, faster or slower to make battle plans easier.

The second is the combat screen where one group of soldiers fight another group of the enemy. A squad consisting a maximum of 14 soldiers will fight according to their set battle formation and will act only on the player's real-time battle commands (e.g. attack, forward, retreat, etc.).
The difficulty levels are represented by eight opponents, which include the Greek goddess of war Athena, a stereotypical Russian-Soviet commander named Crazy Ivan, as well as the historical characters Alexander the Great, Julius Caesar, Genghis Khan, Napoleon, Geronimo, and Sun Tzu as the hardest opponent. Each opponent has a different fighting style of combat and strategy.

The game also comes with a construction set which allows the player to create own campaigns: From the story, rules to the map editor. In this game editor, the player can also tweak troops to the player's liking, such as default troop formations.

124655.overview:
A supercomputer in the most remote part of a distant galaxy has become crazy and threatens to destroy the planet. You have been chosen to be the central link of the support command which will try to give a solution for it. But don't worry, you have been educated and trained in the Golden Ring space station, the hardest survival school of the galactic confederation.

Besides, your ship is equipped with the ultimate devices which will allow you to travel safely by the well-known universe. The Combat Mode, where you can activate a panel with a system to locate and to destroy your enemies and the Control System via Menus, both make La Aventura Espacial a new concept in the graphic-conversational adventure.

First of all, your mission is to find your companions, whom are distributed by all the universe, and together with them you must arrive to the central base of the Dark Threat. There, you will have to deal one on one with the computer. It's not an easy task, but you are the last hope of the humanity. All the galaxy has its destiny in your hands.

124657.overview:
In the mid-'70s, an unusual phenomenon took place: two Americans, Willie Crowther and Don Woods wrote the first text adventure game: it was the Original Adventure and was written in Fortran for a DEC PDP-10 and occupied more than 300 K of memory. It gathered a cult following from the elite programmers who knew how to connect to the data bank where it was located, and like all cults, it had its first "martyrs"; several important programmers were fired after becoming "addicted" to it, found playing it late at night while understood to be working overtime instead.

In the United States it was the base that inspired Scott Adams to begin with his famous adventures. In Great Britain, Peter Austin, founder of Level 9, the most prestigious English adventure game company, confessed to be impelled by it from his beginnings as a game designer (one of his first adventures was a version of the Original Adventure). In Spain, there was a similar story, since the first Spanish company dedicated exclusively to text adventures (Aventuras AD), made its reputation based on a game curiously called "La Aventura Original" (yes, based on the legendary one), the fruit of 8 months of investigation and work.

This version, aside from being in Spanish, has with several points worth mentioning, such as having more than 100 detailed locations with graphical illustrations; a special routine of exit descriptions (indispensable for guiding the adventurer through this complex world); and the possibility of using accents, "ñ"'s and opening interrogation and exclamation signs. As well, every object of your inventory is described in text and graphic form. The characters also use the PSI system, so they are not mere objects with human names, but will listen to you and respond -- but most importantly, will act according to how you treat them.

124862.overview:
A platform game resembling Mario and Wonderboy quite strongly. Kid must rescue the woman he loves by crossing 6 worlds, each split into 4 levels. There are a range of baddies to beat, following pre-set attack patterns or just staying on the spot, to be killed using your sword.

Once killed most release things like tokens, keys (sometimes required to open end-of-level doors), apples (for extra energy) and occasionally poison. There are lots of semi-hidden sections and bonus areas to find and explore, including bonus arcade games and fruit machines. Every world ends with a boss.

130389.overview:
The Flintstones is a game based on the popular cartoon series of the same name by Hanna-Barbera Productions Inc.

It's the weekend! Fred Flintstone thinks of only one thing: bowling with his friend and neighbor Barney. Unfortunately, his wife Wilma has got other plans for him. Fred has to paint the living room and Wilma is not going to help him with it. No, she goes shopping. And if that's not enough, Wilma also tells Fred that his mother-in-law is coming over.

131855.overview: You are Carlos, a fat man wearing a black beard and bright coverall. You start your travels accompanied by a parrot in the jungles full of animals. During the game you should jump your way through 5 different levels full of different inhabitants (such as clowns, rats, monkeys, golf-players, etc.), climbing the ladders, entering the passageways to teleport to another locations, using the supporting devices (such as powder kegs to jump higher), collecting the different kinds of useful items from the chests, killing the enemies jumping over them, blowing them away summoning the limited amount of whirlwinds in the visible area, or morphing to the bull for limited amount of times. The parrot is flying over you and helping you to eliminate the flying enemies. On each level you have to gather the keys to open the gates, push some switches or levers, and collect certain items for some kind of picture.

135319.overview:
Brian Lara Cricket '96 is an updated version of Brian Lara Cricket. It is basically the same game, with updated sprites and roster.

The game features international matches, English county matches (with 18 teams) and 6 classic historical matches (from 1960 to 1994). Also available are the World Cup competition (with 12 national teams) and a Test Series. The game also features a team editor, battery back-up save and one to four multiplayer mode.

140038.overview: Billy The Kid is a action/adventure hybrid in the style of Cinemaware's It Came From The Desert game, except this time you can play as either the legendary outlaw, or Sheriff Pat Garrett, the sheriff who hunted him down. The game is action-oriented, although you must follow the plot to know what to do next (as Billy the Kid, for example, your first task is to rob the bank). Most action sequences are either first-person gunfights (similar to Virtua Squad), or top-down action on horseback. The gameworld is vast: you will be able to visit numerous towns in the wild west from Santa Fe to El Paso, as well as forts, Indian settlements, and more. Naturally, each character has his own plot as well as unique action sequences. Stumble upon the outlaw's campfire as the sheriff, for example, and you will have to hunt them down in an action sequence; visit it as Billy the Kid, and you will meet fellow outlaws who will share tips and dispense clues.

140163.overview:
As an intrepid explorer, buy equipments, tools. and head into the wild Yucatan jungles to find the mysterious Mayan fetish.

Two modes are available: a platform mode and a 3D mode where the player drives a Jeep.

140708.overview:
The plot of Golden Eagle is a basic one: the evil priest Nahmur stole the Golden Eagle, severed it into five parts and hid them in the city. The player controls a special agent with the order (the employees are mutants) to find said parts.

So the player walks through the levels while shooting all opposition. There are also some basic puzzles to solve (collecting an item at one place and using it at another or switch puzzles) and safes to open (either with found codes or by using special equipment) in order to find the eagle parts. There are also some traps to avoid.

Besides walking and moving, the protagonist can jump and duck. All other actions like crawling can only be performed in certain places. Using terminals reveal useful information in the form of messages or a map for easier orientation. Other terminals offer the possibility to play a completely optional game of Reversi.

141822.overview:
A puzzle game where the main goal is to make loops! Random pieces are presented over a board, including simple lines and corners as well as S bends and other warped shapes, of varying sizes. It is up to the player to link them up in a loop form, then moving on to the next level. Pieces can be placed on any empty space on the grid, and rotated into one of the four main compass directions.

Any pieces which are not part of the finished loop when a level is completed are left on the screen, so there is value in playing towards 2 distinct loops, to ensure that you have options depending on which pieces are drawn - unlike Pipe Dream there are no clues as to which pieces are coming next.

Three play modes are available, two of which can be played with two players. Game A is freestyle - simply make loops, gaining extra points for size and style. 

Game B is about unlocking bonus boards of the game by reaching a certain score and uses a bonus multiplier method depending on loop difficulty.

The third mode of play begins with an already made loop and then removes random pieces of it, so the player has to put them back in when they appear again. It is essentially a memory test and logic puzzle of fitting the pieces back as one remembers - although placing a piece where it seems to fit is also often effective.

141857.overview:
The Amiga game based on the 1993 Arnold Schwarzenegger vehicle Last Action Hero is a side-scrolling brawler in the vein of Double Dragon or Final Fight.

The player controls action hero Jack Slater through five levels, including the streets, a warehouse, Slater's home and more. He must beat up a number of thugs with a variety of punches and kicks, a somersault, or a knee to the groin, all while slowly moving to the end of the level. Up to four goons will attack at the same time. In the later levels, some are armed with guns. At the end of each level a boss fight against a more powerful villain follows. These include the main antagonists from the movie like Benedict and Slater's arch enemy the Ripper, but also some characters thought up for the game only. Most of them don't play fair and will have some regular thugs coming to their aid.

Slater starts the game with a limited number of lives, which can be increased by picking up golden movie tickets lying about in trash cans or other containers. Sound-wise the game features a sample of Arnold's famous one-liner "I'll be back" and guitar-heavy rock tracks as music.

141858.overview:
In Leavin' Teramis the titular space ship gets conquered by aliens. The whole crew has managed to flee - except Nigel MacGibbons who slept through the evacuation due to his nightly drinking activities. Now he needs to reach the last escape pod by finding his way through ten levels, all with a big boss at the end.

From an overhead perspective, the player controls MacGibbons through the corridors and rooms of the ship, scrolling in multiple directions. Despite controlling a human instead of a ship, the game is a straight shooter: using a gun to kill everything that moves while dodging enemy attacks and bullets. Getting hit reduces the energy bar and when it reaches zero, a life is lost. Special symbols give advantages when picked up, like extra time on the time limit, extra lives or weapon upgrades.

141859.overview:
Unusually, this Operation Wolf-influenced shoot 'em up sees you start behind enemy lines, and gradually attempting to escape. As you've captured the Rapier machine gun your enemy have been developing, there are plenty who can't bear to see the back of you unless it's bloodied and lifeless.

The game's 8 levels feature quite a variety of settings, vehicles and situations. You will have to evade fire from snipers based in windows, enemy jets, helicopters and well-trained marines, while riding tanks and speedboats as well as being on foot. The levels are set in locations such as the enemy camp, the jungle, a ruined city and the final flight back to your base.

141860.overview:
Logo features three independent puzzle games with 120 levels each. The main motivational factor are digitized, more or less naked women that appear between levels. All levels have to be solved within a time limit and a password is given once every five levels. In game one and three, all moves can be undone.

In the first game, the player needs to recreate a stone combination shown in the lower part of the screen. To do so, he places a single stone on the playfield. However, each stone also has a value between one and four which needs to be matched. Every time a stone is placed besides another stone, the value of the stone already on the field rises by one. If the value was already four, it resets to one.

In the second game, a pre-defined stone combination has to be erased. To do so, the player clicks on a stone which then disappears. But the stones around the clicked stone (left, right, above and below) also disappear. If there is no stone on a clicked place or a place around it, one is created.

In the third game, the goal is the same as in game two. However, only two stones of the same value and colour can be taken from the playfield. The value of the stones around a taken stone rises by one.

141872.overview:
The Neverending Story II is a platform game which is largely based on the movie. The concept is simple: you're Bastian, and are called forth once again by the Childlike Empress to save Fantasia, the Land of Dreams.

The game itself is indeed a platformer where you have to outrun giants (as in the movie) or push them over ledges. With every level you will be awarded with another advancement in the plot, usually a few pages written on a "book".

141897.overview:
La Colmena (aka The Beehive) is a video game published in 1992 on Amiga by Opera Soft S.A.. It's a strategy game, set in an adult, board / party game. La Colmena is inspired by an erotic table game (The Pyramid of Love), the purpose of which is to join together several adult people. During the course of the game, the participants will have to surpass certain tests and challenges. In the later portions of game, the tests will be more and more stimulating, and the participants will be taking off their clothes.

The game has many different sub-games, like roulette, blackjack, and poker, and during the game many general thematic questions need to be answered. It also features humorous scenes and conversations.

141959.overview: Puff is a poor little dragon who decides to explore the world beyond his home - Dragonland. Unfortunately, he is now lost and wants to go back home! Puff is too little to do this adventure by himself so you have to guide him through many levels, solving puzzles, avoiding traps and find all four parts of the pass to get back into Dragonland.

142890.overview: Pac Man with a twist. Each section is guarded by gates and to get to the next section of dots, you must successfully answer a trivia\quiz question. The person who gets to the most sections wins.

142928.overview: Another great game, unreleased game, a Jump'n Run shooter. There's certainly a mash up of GODS and Myth going on here, with the way the player deals with the enemies. But I can't help but notice the very dark nature of the game, with some very creepy mutated looking creatures, soulless landscapes and gritty soundtracks

143294.overview:
This game is based on the Spanish animation series of the same name, broadcast on Televisión Española during the late eighties, so as in the TV series, the action will take place in the System of the Double Sun, composed of seven planets (some inhabited and some not) and twelve moons; but the planet we should take care of is the third, where our friends live, ruled by King Brigal and his son, Prince Zalk.

Rahman, the all-powerful wizard of the kingdom, is in possession of the Magic Crown, a mysterious crown with far-reaching powers which keeps the balance of forces between him and the wicked witch Idun and her armies, led by the sinister Zohak, the witch's vizier. They live on the last three planets in the System, the Lost Planets, and you, throughout six arcade levels, must try to recover the crown, for it, you will have to deal with fantastic creatures, evil wizards and witches, helped by your strength and magical powers, until arriving at the final encounter with Rahman.

143430.overview:
Based on the graphic novel of the same name, this computer game Quest for the Time-Bird is a marvellous saga whose principal ingredients are action, danger, suspense, fantasy and magic.

You have nine days to complete your quest by exploring this vast unknown world of wizards and spells with Roxanna, daughter of Mara the witch and Bragon, a retired knight who once again goes back into life of danger, all for the great Quest of the Time-Bird!

145199.overview:
Last Battle is a side-scrolling beat-em-up game in which the player takes control of a martial artist named Aarzak who must single-handedly (and -footedly) defeat the lackeys of an evil fighter called Duke, and eventually stand against three generals who have kidnapped his girlfriend. The hero fights using punches and kicks, combining these moves with jumping and crouching. He also has a special power meter that refills over the time. When the power meter is full, Aarzak gains a boost that allows him to perform rapid attacks for the rest of the stage.

Most of the levels are simple scrolling areas that the player needs to complete within a time limit. Some levels, however, are more maze-like, requiring the player to explore them in order to find the exit. Bosses await Aarzak at the end of most stages. He will also encounter allies who will increase his offensive or defensive strength, or replenish his health.

The original Japanese version is based on the Fist of the North Star manga and anime; the protagonist is Kenshiro, the main hero of the series. All character names have been changed in the translated version, which also has reduced gore. However, the rest of the visuals, gameplay, and locations remain identical.

150325.overview:
After the total overwhelming defeat of the aliens that Black Dawn II dealt with, you were betrayed and thrown back into the jail of the Interplanetary Space and Time Report (KGB analogue). However, you managed to escape and release another eight prisoners with the sole purpose of finding Kane where you were imprisoned for seven years and which in the meantime became home to demons, battered humanoids, various androids, and other monsters. Here you have to catch up with your biggest enemy - traitor Nick. To achieve your goal, you have to break over 20 (in full version) of the strength of evil and, of course, survive, which, as we will be talking about, is not that simple.

In the initial election you must first select your hero from the nine possible ones. Initial choice depends to a certain extent, because everyone has different equipment, different numbers of money, and has different qualities. Once you've chosen, you can either read instructions for control, and so on, where you can really read a lot of useful things or start playing.

154978.overview: Leviathan takes place on isometric science-fiction landscapes where all enemies have to be destroyed. So the player mans a space ship, flies around the three levels (with the ability to turn around and change the flying height) and shoots everything he see. Besides flying enemies there are also defense stations on the ground to be dealt with. But while rocket ammo is unlimited, fuel has to be regularly refilled by landing besides a fuel pod. Three smart bombs which destroy everything on the screen help in tight situations. Every level runs on a time limit.

154979.overview: Limes & Napoleon is a competition of two robots ("Limes" and "Napoleon"), in which it is about to complete various skill exercises. The winner of the competition will be used to search for precious metals on distant planets and the loser will be disposed of. The player has the task of "flicking" the flashing "Glidstar", which is located in the middle of the field, and into the opponent's goal. The opponent in turn has the option to "hang in" to push his adversary off his feet, then to einrüsseln the Glidstar himself. On the field is also "Bufo", a troublemaker who also rips the robots off his feet. The game is mainly based on the 2-player mode, but can also be played against the computer. Each robot has a spare body. The player can freely change the control of the respective body in the game.

155860.overview:
Lord of Alcandria: Chapter II begins in an empty graveyard in the middle of the night. Suddenly a burst of magical sparkles appears, then disappears, above one of the gravestones. A moment later, a gray hand pushes up through the earth...

In this fantasy point & click adventure game, you take on the role of the reanimated corpse of Krilok Rainwood, 13th century warrior. Your first task is find out who just performed your resurrection, and what they have planned for you.

155861.overview: Lord of Alcandria: Chapter III is a fantasy point & click adventure game. As in Chapter II, you play Krilok Rainwood, a scythe-wielding member of the undead. The game opens on a bright sunny morning as Krilok wakes up by the side of a winding road that leads off to a castle in the distance. He meets a group of rebels hiding out in the forest nearby, and with their help, he hatches a plan to infiltrate the King's stronghold.

158269.overview: The alien race Hellraisers seized the planet Hazbal which is an important junction of space trade routes. The player's job is to drive them out of the system. The game consists of six levels with two alternating gameplay mechanics. In the first, third and fifth level the player controls the mercenary himself who walks and jumps through the side-scrolling levels. With his weapon he shoots everything that moves and uses teleporters and holes to find his way. The other levels are horizontally shooters in a top-down perspective. The player controls a space ship, moves through the levels and shoots everything that moves. Killed enemies may leave symbols behind which give advantages when picked up.

158359.overview:
A good alternate title for this one would be Rows - not the kind you have when your wife finds lipstick on your shirt collar, but as an equivalent of Columns. The gameplay is essentially the same - groups of 3 variably-colored blocks fall towards the bottom of a 6x18 grid, and you must arrange them into groups of 3 of the same colour - except that the blocks are grouped horizontally rather than vertically.

Each individual brick falls as far as it can when you place the trio, so they won't necessarily all end up on the same line. Blocks fall as far as possible to fill gaps when lines are completed, so there are never gaps in the arrangement the way you get in Tetris. Each level sets you a target number of lines to form - 4 or 5 in a row count as 2 and 3 lines respectively for this calculation, a lá Klax. Horizontal lines score the least, with diagonals the most lucrative and vertical in between (this change from Columns makes sense considering the different building method).

158435.overview: Lethal Zone is a German horizontal shooter in the same vein as the R-Type series of games. You control a spaceship and you shoot enemy ships and obstacles, while avoiding projectiles and crashing on any surface. Holding the fire button and releasing it increases the power of your shots, while hitting it repeatedly lets out a stream of them. The destroyed enemies occasionally leave behind power-ups that can be collected. They increase and modify the power of your shots. You start with 5 lives, and at each 50.000 points you receive an extra one. The games has four levels, each with a unique "boss" enemy at the end.

158436.overview:
A peaceful Tuesday afternoon in the Pleasuredome, 2068. That was the last time you saw your beloved princess, Diora. The evil Okiraclan of space pirates snatched her from your arms, and are now holding the Empire to ransom...

You decide that you must go and find her. All reasons says that you will never make it; but love drives you on. You must search three planets to find your princess, and each one will be heavily guarded with highly trained Okira warriors. Find that planet Diora is being held on, destroy the pirates, and a fairy will grant you a single wish.

Love and magic will help you win the day - you must not fail in this mission. Collect power points to recharge your guns and life-support systems as you battle through the planets. You will also need fuel for your ship, if you are to make it to the next planet.

159663.overview: This 1992 New Year Special Edition release was not official, but instead is a hacked scene release by Fairlight.

169446.overview:
You start out as a rookie detective whose job is to track down a crop of thieves stealing the world's most precious treasures. After each assignment briefing, you'll be given a deadline to capture the thief that stole the artifact using clues dealing with your knowledge of geography.

The game is an updated version of the original Where in the World is Carmen Sandiego?, featuring enhanced graphics, sound effects, and additional control schemes, such as joystick support for computer platforms.

171564.overview:
The Ultimate Pinball Quest boasts of "the largest pinball table ever created", and can back it up with the 99-level table "Wasteland", along with two others of smaller size. While the level of quality may be higher in more traditional pinball games, the sheer size of the tables is quite impressive.

The game features three modes. Adventure, in which the three tables are connected; arcade, which is the traditional style allowing you to select any of the three tables; and bonus, allowing you to play the six bonus stages.

While the Arcade and Bonus modes require no explanation, the adventure mode does. It starts you out in the Wasteland, but has hidden links to both of the other tables, similar to the links to the bonus tables, but much less common. Also of note is the storyline that attempts to provide a background to the game.

177921.overview:
The Lost Treasures of Infocom is a collection of 20 computer games from interactive fiction pioneer Infocom, released in 1991. It was available in MS-DOS, Macintosh, Amiga, and Apple IIGS versions, as well as a cross-platform CD-ROM version, followed by a re-release on the Apple Computer iOS platform in 2012. Infocom was closed in 1989 by its then-parent company Activision. Still holding the copyright to nearly all the past Infocom titles, Activision bundled 20 of the most popular into this package. 

The games included are: 

-    Ballyhoo
-    Beyond Zork: The Coconut of Quendor 
-    Deadline
-    Enchanter
-    The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
-    Infidel
-    Lurking Horror
-    Moonmist
-    Planetfall
-    Starcross
-    Stationfall
-    Sorcerer
-    Spellbreaker
-    Suspect
-    Suspended
-    The Witness Zork I: The Great Underground Empire
-    Zork II: The Wizard of Frobozz
-    Zork III: The Dungeon Master
-    Zork Zero: The Revenge of Megaboz

178151.overview:
The scene chosen for this adventure, the first one of the "Ci-U-Than" trilogy, is the Yucatan, a mysterious land in which legends say there are a lot of dangers, hidden treasures, unsolved mysteries, temples filled with traps... in short, the ingredients to which the good adventurer is used to deal with.

The adventure is developed in the island of Cozumel, where you must guide an archaeologist who had an incident. He was sailing towards it perfectly equipped, when an unfortunate shipwreck left him without anything. Do not think he only lost the map or the machete, no, he lost everything, including the trousers and the underclothes, reason why it's quite possible that an entrance in San Marcos, coastal town near the place of the shipwreck, would carry serious problems with the justice. The main mission of the adventure is to discover all the hidden secrets of the island and then be able to escape from it.

This game uses the habitual commands of the previous AD adventures, plus the inclusion of some PSI characters, it means, personages with own personality, decision capacity, different behavior according to the development of the adventure, that is, personages who must be treated as if they were real since their reactions can vary from a game to another. Some improvements like the objects treatment system have been incorporated (which include all their qualities); a better graphical detail; a score system that it indicates you which actions are positive and which negative, etc.

178153.overview: Los Templos Sagrados is a Spanish text-adventure, the sequel to La Diosa de Cozumel, and the second "book" of the "Ci-U-Than" trilogy of games. They all utilize the parser DAAD, that has capabilities similar to the Infocom Z-machine one (you can chain commands, correct misspellings, etc). This time around the player searches the ruins of the Yucatán peninsula for the lost mayan temple of Chichén Itzá.

178244.overview:
The first part of Simulmondo's Italian SPIDER-MAN trilogy. 

Spiderman - Episode 1: The Return of Hobgoblin or Spider-Man - Episode 1: The Return of Hobgoblin is a point-and-click adventure with action elements. It was developed by Italian company Simulmondo and also came out for Amiga. As the title suggests, it is the first part of a series of episodes The story starts with Liz Allan, the former wife of Green Goblin, calling Peter Parker for help, as she is being threatened by the Hobgoblin.
While being a point-and-click adventure, the game also features direct controls. Occasionally, Spiderman has to fight villains, and their some fighting mechanics for that. Spiderman can punch or use his web sling as weapon. He can also duck, jump and run.

178245.overview:
Second part of Simulmondo's Italian SPIDER-MAN trilogy. 
 
L'Uomo Ragno 2: ...E Ora, Carnage! is a point and click Adventure game, developed and published by Simulmondo, which was released in Europe in 1994. Spiderman - Episodio 2: E ora, Carnage or L'Uomo Ragno - Episodio 2: E ora, Carnage is a point-and-click adventure with action elements. It was developed by Italian company Simulmondo and was also released for the Amiga. As the title suggests, it is the first part of a series of episodes. The second episode starts with Peter Parker sent to a church where the priest claims a demonic creature is lurking in the shadows. As it turns out, Carnage is behind this.

While being a point-and-click adventure, the game also features direct controls. Occasionally, Spiderman has to fight villains, and their some fighting mechanics for that. Spiderman can punch or use his web sling as weapon. He can also duck, jump and run.

178246.overview:
An Italian language game with a mix of Adventure and Beat 'm up elements. Spiderman - Episodio 3: Destino Incrociato! ("Entwined Destiny!" - note that Dr. Doom is called "Dottor Destino" in Italy) or L'Uomo Ragno: Destino Incrociato! is a point-and-click adventure with action elements. It was developed by Italian company Simulmondo. It is the third and last part of Simulmondo's series of episodic Spiderman adventures. It also came out for Amiga. As far as I know, all episodes where only released in Italian language.
This time, Dr. Doom sets out to steal a precious emerald from a museum in New York. He needs the stone for his latest scheme to take over the world.
While being a point-and-click adventure, the game also features direct controls. Occasionally, Spiderman has to fight villains, and their some fighting mechanics for that. Spiderman can punch or use his web sling as weapon. He can also duck, jump and run.

181256.overview: European version(s) of the popular US TV game show Wheel of Fortune. A very basic translation of the popular game show Wheel Of Fortune, where you guess letters until you can guess the phrase. This CGA version has three old-school rounds of Wheel of Fortune (where the puzzles are simply "Phrase", "Title", "Person", etc.) and then a bonus round. You can compete against 2 computer players or up to three people can play against each other.

181305.overview: Bosse Des Maths 3eme is an educational adventure game in French, developed and published by Coktel Vision, which was released in Europe in 1988.

181307.overview:
"Le Declic" is an Italian X-rated comic strip, created by Milo Manara.
This is no ordinary adventure but more an interactive comic strip.

181308.overview:
An old-fashioned football management game, in which you take over one of 64 clubs and try to lead them to glory. The choice is fairly arbitrary, as you can rename the team, you always start in the lowest of the four divisions, and the kits aren't real-life.

You start with only 11 players, and the maximum is 15, so you'll be keen to sign new players, and you get this opportunity after each match, when a player is offered, with his skill and form displayed. You can train your players to improve these skills, and sell players you don't rate highly.

Matches are played out via a succession of short animations, in which the home side wears red and the away side blue. At full time you are told how many injuries were incurred. The league season features 15 matches, one against each team, with the top two teams gaining promotion.

181311.overview: Leeds United Champions! is a managerial soccer simulation in which the player takes control of Leeds United, the English champions of the 1991/92 season, in the fourth division; the goal being to conquer the Premier League in the long run. The game is completely menu based and the sub-menus are reached through a list of icons in the main menu. In those menus the player can set all the usual options of the genre, e.g. training, transfer market, lineup, ticket prices, youth section or stadium expansion. There is no match presentation to speak of; just a screen representing a live ticker which gives out the goals and bookings. Each athlete has 15 stats which influence his performance on the field.

181312.overview:
THE JUNIOR WOODCHUCKS IN THE WOODS.
(This is the youth organization to which Donald Duck's nephews, Huey, Dewey and Louie, belong.)

181313.overview:
Trois Petits Cochons s'Amusent is an education game, developed and published by Coktel Vision, which was released in Europe in 1989. Mainly intended for small(er) children. English translation: THE THREE LITTLE PIGS ARE HAVING A GOOD TIME.

Loosely based on the 1933 Disney short film THREE LITTLE PIGS, directed by Burt Gillett, now considered an all-time cartoon classic.

The game requires the user to write-enable the game disk. Failing to do so will prevent the game from running.

181315.overview: This game is an unofficial conversion of the original Lode Runner. Hans Courbois, just took advantage of the lack of official conversion on Amiga to sell a complete rip without even a credit to Doug Smith or Brøderbund.

181704.overview: Le Labyrinthe aux Mille Calculs (The Labyrinth with a Thousand Calculations) is an educational game, developed and published by RETZ, which was released in Europe in 1989.

181742.overview: This game is a mix of educational game and point-and-click adventure, with a strong emphasis on "educational", since apart from a handful of traps, there are almost no puzzles to solve, you are rather supposed to gain points awarded in the game by answering the questions correctly, thus improving your English grammar skills.

181778.overview: The sequel to Le Labyrinthe d'Anglomania 1 and not much has changed. Different questions and screens but pretty much the same game. Another educational title that helps you to improve your English grammar.

181781.overview:
As knight of the realm, King Littré the First entrust a mission to you to ensure that French is well written in all provinces of his kingdom. Indeed, a grammar book was written by enchanter Grévisse, but the machiavellian sorcerer Errare locked the enchanter in a maze, hid the grammar book in its treasure and cursed all the copyists, who make pages full of mistakes. Your mission is to rescue everyone, identify mistakes and destroy the wrong pages, save the copyists and find the 4 keys that will lead to treasure and grammar book.

Ingame, you must move your hero through the maze and enter the rooms that come to you to answer questions about French grammar or fight the minions of sorcerer Errare. Your moves are made between static displays in a third-person view or, more rarely, a first-person one. Each intersection results in a choice of a direction or action similarly to "a thrilling fantasy adventure in which YOU are the hero". Puzzles are based on multiple choice questions. You will gain some magic items and letters, but errors will lead to loss of hit points, which will make you more vulnerable in future battles. Encounters with the monsters take place suddenly and automatically, and only the comparison between your health and the one of your opponents will determine the winner of the fight. If defeated, you will die and have to restart the game from the beginning. After defeating Errare, your only chance to open treasure and free the grammar book is to find the correct password, so be sure to collect enough magic letters to reconstruct the password before starting the final fight!

Le Labyrinthe d'Errare aims 11-14 year-old children and is part of a larger series of games "Labyrithe" by Dominique Grandpierre, on every possible subjects. Its strict equivalent for 8-10 year-old children is called "Le Labyrithe d'Orthopus".

181784.overview: Le Labyrinthe d'Orthophus is almost the same as Le Labyrinthe d'Errare but with the puzzles and questions aimed at 8-10 year olds.

181803.overview: Le Labyrinthe de la Reine des Ombres (The Labyrinth of the Queen of Shadows) is an educational adventure type game in which you, in the company of the white rabbit, will enter the mysterious kingdom of shadows and live an extraordinary adventure. In order to rescue the inhabitants, prisoners of the evil one, You're gonna have to beat the Queen. Helped by the twins, you will have to thwart her traps and spells and solve the riddles you encounter. Thanks to your vivacity, your cunning, perhaps you will emerge victorious. Good Luck.

181821.overview: You are captain of the UPS (United Planetary Systems). Using your ASTRO 2020 spacecraft you have just landed on the planet Morphinax. Your objective is to reach the seat of the supreme council, to uncover its secrets and to establish fruitful relationships with the inhabitants. So maybe you will find the trace of the missing telstor 3 rocket crew. You have ten days to reach the goal. Morphinax is populated by Roulasses, Borets and Flaquimarions with unexpected reactions. They sometimes have a bad temper and easily attack travelers who do not answer their questions correctly. In addition, we meet beings on this planet with terrifying powers ... You will need a lot of strength and intelligence to accomplish your mission. But, let's not forget, you are a Super Hero. Good luck! The people of Morphinax are crazy about vocabulary, the questions they will ask you will allow you to better know our language.

181864.overview: The Last Soldier is a platform shooter game. The player's main goal is to turn on four reactors located in a secret Nazi bunker. The base is full of soldiers, mini tanks, rocket launchers, automatic turrets, laser beams and other deadly objects. The main character is equipped with an AK47 7.22MM Kalashnikov with limited ammo, which can be replenished by collecting boxes of ammunition scattered around the bunker. The player may also find medi-kits, pass keys, access codes, a gasoline canister and many other useful items that should be used in the appropriate place. A fall from a great height means a certain death.

181869.overview: Leader Board Tournament Disk #1 was an addon to the original Leader Board Golf game. It adds 4 more courses to the brilliant game play that made Leader Board one of the best golf games of it's era. The ability to have 4 players competing made it one of the best multiplayer experiences around. The 4 courses in this game are quite tough and require accurate shot placement to sustain a good score.

181897.overview: Lettrix is a puzzle game in which the player gets presented with a structure, e.g. a big "A". This needs to be rebuilt by using eight differently formed blocks (some reminiscent of Tetris shapes) which can be rotated and placed on the playfield. Those blocks are limited in number, e.g. the player may have ten of one and six of another available to use. Wrongly placed blocks can be picked up again, but the player fights against a time limit. When playing with two players, they work together at the same puzzle and alternate their moves.

181904.overview: Light Racer is a Tron Light Cycle clone which is actually not too bad. It's a German made game so don't expect to know what is being said in the digitized sound intro or the text in the game, unless you know German. The game itself is pretty basic but can be quite addictive. There are various options and extras to turn on in the settings. The game also seems to be 2 player game.

184792.overview: Links: Championship Course: Firestone Country Club is a golf course add-on for Links: The Challenge of Golf. The add-on features the South Course of Firestone Country Club in Akron, Ohio.

192886.overview: A puzzle game in which the player's task is to connect corridors in such a way that they colour red. The blocks can be rotated, and in each board, all the objectives related to the number of connections must be met. In further boards, the blocks are manipulated by moving them using the arrows at the edges of the board.

205464.overview:
Versions for MS-DOS and Amiga were both produced in 1994, however the episodic publication of the Amiga version was cancelled in the wake of Commodore's demise. In 2007, coder Fabrizio Farenga made the entire series freely downloadable on his homepage, effectively marking the first Amiga release of the game.

The game follows the story of a young boy named Richard, who is magically transported to a fantasy world. There, a man named Golan recognizes him as the Chosen One who is set to restore balance in the world. Richard's task is to retrieve six lost gems, each held by a guardian at the service of the Evil One, and take them all to the Tree of Life.

La Storia Ancestrale is a point-and-click adventure game on fixed screens from a two-dimensional side view. Left-clicking on an object or exit causes Richard to walk there, right-clicking will have him look at the object, whereas left-clicking while holding the right button will perform a default action such as pick up or talk. There is a single "use" verb for objects in the inventory, which varies in effect depending on Richard's location. Occasionally, Richard will have to fight monsters in an arcade sequence with a crossbow.

205607.overview: Leader Board, the first game in the series, was released in 1986 and included four different water-based courses.

211016.overview: This is fan-made conversion of the C64 homebrew game Lumberjack. Visuals and music have been improved, gameplay is virtually the same. You are a Lumberjack who tries to chop down a tree as fast as he can without getting hit by branches from above. Sometimes women's clothing is stuck in the branches and collecting it will net you a nice bonus. I am not certain, but this might be inspiried by Monthy Python's skit "The Lumberjack Song".

211019.overview: The Last StarFighter Amiga shooter made in AMOS, based on the universal pictures movie from 1984.

211025.overview:
The Lost Prince is a fantasy point & click graphic adventure for the Amiga, created in AMOS. The game has a LucasArts-style action bar with six mode buttons: "Examine", "Use", "Use ... on", "Take", "Talk to" and "Options". Use the left mouse button to walk and to select action buttons, and the right mouse button to perform an action on a selected object or character. The pathfinding algorithm is imperfect, and sometimes you will need to guide the character manually around obstacles by clicking several points along the way.

The main character is young Prince Rindlepoke, who lived in a magnificent castle and liked to play the harp. One day he was kidnapped and taken away on a ship, but a sudden storm gave him the opportunity to escape. The game begins as he washes up alone on an unfamiliar beach. From here, there are a few places he can walk to: a cave near the top of a large hill, a dark grey stone castle with a moat, and several small businesses operating in the local village.

The Lost Prince was the second graphic adventure released by DTO Software, after "Starbase 13" (1993). The engine created for The Lost Prince later formed the basis of GR.A.C., an adventure game authoring system released in 1995.

211028.overview: Last Lap is a racing game, published by Sublime Software, which was released in Europe in 1995.

211030.overview:
Lethal Formula is a sci-fi point & click graphic adventure about a scientist who has made a major discovery that could help the world, but the corporation he was working for is planning to use his research for far more sinister purposes. Feeling that there is no other option, he decides to take matters into his own hands to stop them.

Lethal Formula was one of the demo games to be bundled with GR.A.C. (the "GRaphic Adventure Creator"), an adventure game authoring system for the Amiga. Like all GR.A.C. games, the controls are slightly unusual: the left mouse button is only used for making the character walk, and for selecting verb action buttons. To actually perform an action on an object, you need to right-click.

211075.overview: Using your light saber, board the rebel scum ship and make your way past insolent droids and consular guards and crush the rebellion! Block shots with your sword, pick up dark side energy boosts and take out your former master. Then follow the rebels to Hoth base and drive them off planet. Follow them to Cloud City and put the scoundrel in ice. Finally fight the Emperor for your son, if you dare!

211077.overview: Lumberjack Platform is a single screen platform game where you fully embrace the life as a lumberjack, using thrown axes to take out wood trolls that leave behind some nice logs for you. Gather up all your wood and head for the door. Avoid the water, it will rust your axes and the fishes are fierce. Avoid the spikes, they don't look comfortable at all!

211091.overview: Legend of Rome is a Strategy game, developed by MBM Software and published by CPU Italian, which was released in Europe in 1994.

211092.overview: Landfill is written in C and features music from EAB's very own saimon69. Landfill is a little like Tetris or Columns but with its own unique gameplay. Here, you have a chain of household items. You remove items by matching them with the next item in the chain. As the game progresses, new items appear and it becomes a rapid memory game. You can use the fire button to swap with items to the left or right.

211223.overview: Just as in real life, you only have one life to give, but and endless amount of ammo.

211255.overview: In this very Bruce Lee like Platforming game, hearts must be collected to complete the level. Love Dungeon is a simple arcade game about collecting Hearts against the clock, there is NO ADULT CONTENT in this game, just a suggestive title!

211373.overview: Lasermania 2 is an enhanced version of the first part, released back in 1990 for Atari platform. The aim is to destroy designated objects by means of a laser beam. The direction of the laser beam can be changed by using polished pipe elements. Before firing the laser beam, player must remove all obstacles by moving them or blowing up with bombs.

211374.overview: A platformer created by Simon Keogh in the style of single-screen platfomers, where you must solve the level, get safely to the gold, while avoiding the redshirt baddies to move to the next one. Musically, way above average.

211498.overview:
In the western desert plains, a desolate landscape is cut by the railroad that will connect the two coasts of the North American continent. The railway is a steamroller that destroys everything in its path, farmers, ranchers, towns and Indian tribes … for this he has taken control of an army of armed men and also has the support of the government who sent troops. All this so that nothing can stop the railroad.

In a skirmish between some ranchers and the railroad gunmen, our protagonist is left for dead, his land is confiscated, and his entire world disappears. When he wakes up in the desert, he decides to come back as a masked man and get revenge on the railroad. But not only are the railroad and its henchmen the only dangers our lone vigilante faces, there are also dangerous animals on the plains and of course the plains Indians who are on the warpath and attack all those who enter. in their lands... Fight your way with your revolver and the aid of your horse to those at the head of the railroad company...

211560.overview: A French point and click adventure game made by with code by Sylvain Martinez (Sa Majesté) and music and graphics by Eric Cubizolle (Titan).

211567.overview: The premise of LIMBO OF THE LOST is loosely based on the merchant vessel mystery of the Mary Celeste. "Limbo of the Lost" in its own right is the name of a mythical quadrant of the Sargasso Sea, alternatively known as the Bermuda Triangle. On the 5th December, 1872 the Mary Celeste was found mysteriously deserted in the Atlantic Ocean, off the coast of the Azores Islands, Portugal. Scheduled for release on the A1200 and CD32 in 1995 by Rasputin, the game wasn't released at the time despite previews appearing in Amiga magazines and the release of a CD32 demo, it was reworked and finally released in full in 2007.

211568.overview: Lost on Parrot Island is a point and click adventure game with an interface similar to early LucasArts adventures. After a shipwreck the player character finds himself on an island in the middle of the Pacific ocean. The task ahead is simple: find a way to leave the island. The player moves around the island screen by screen by clicking on the scenery while other interactions are done with the control panel's six verb command buttons: use, push, talk to, look at, open, close, give and take. Items found around the island can be picked up and will be placed in an eight slot inventory. These can then be used to interact with the game world.

211646.overview:
The Legend of the Elves is a fantasy point & click graphic adventure about a young elf named Eric, who lives with his family on a small island. One day Eric arrives at home, expecting to be greeted by his parents and younger sibling, only to find the house deserted. He finds a note pinned to the wall with a knife that tells him his family has been kidnapped, and there is a hefty ransom for their return. Eric doesn't have the money to pay the ransom, and sets off on a quest to save his family.

The interface splits the screen vertically into two sections: the top half shows the current scene from a third-person perspective, and underneath is a panel that shows the items you are currently carrying, as well as six action buttons: "Pick up", "Talk to", "Use", "Give", "Look at", and "Throw".

211647.overview: Legends of Triten by Andrew Crowe 1998. Amazing cutscenes by Aristides Castiglioni. What a great game, too bad that it had never got a full release.

211874.overview: This PD (Public Domain/Freeware) game is one hell of a big labyrinth. It takes 30 minutes to go through with no mistakes. The mission is to find the purple door, you'll  need to seek your way through a very large labyrinth to do this.There are lots of trap tunnels but taking one of those will cost you much time.

211950.overview: Published in Schatztruhe #1215. Logik is a great thinking and combination game for the whole family. You have to try to recreate a heap of diamonds according to certain rules of the game, which must match the original both in shape and colour. On each level you also play against the clock and have to try to solve the puzzle as quickly as possible. Logik also has an undo function that can be used to correct incorrect moves.

212218.overview: Way back in 1984 Firebird released the Pirate style Arcade Puzzle game 'Booty' for the Amstrad CPC, C64, Commodore Plus/4, and ZX Spectrum. In that game you played as a cabin boy that had to steal treasure from his pirate masters, which meant avoiding other pirates, parrots and booby trapped treasure. If you remembered this rather classic pirate themed game, will be pleased to know that as of today you can download the latest version of 'Looty'; An Amiga game as an inspiration to that classic game of Booty.

212437.overview: A family friendly platform game for the Commodore Amiga originally created for by Gerrit of Night Owl using some graphic elements created by his 8 year old daughter and intended for very family friendly play. Originally listed as an Unpublished game but released on their website in 2014. This was followed by a sequel to this game that continues the princess's journey of collecting the stars and saving the kingdom.

212438.overview: A sequel to the original game that continues the princess's journey of collecting the stars and saving the kingdom. A family friendly platform game for the Commodore Amiga originally created for by Gerrit of Night Owl using some graphic elements created by his 8 year old daughter and intended for very family friendly play. Originally listed as an Unpublished game but released on their website in 2015.

212470.overview:
An interesting mix of Asteroids and Lemmings characters. This shooter uses Lemmings sprites and sound effects to make for some surprising fun, coded by El Caracho and released to public domain in 1993. This time you play as a Umbrella, and you have to shoot Lemmings down to size, sometimes another Lemming will zoom onto the screen, which tries to shoot at you

As you shoot the Lemmings, you get various sound effects, as they gradually get smaller and smaller before they finally die as you fire the last shot

The Lemming Graphics are detailed and well designed, and the Sound Effects are top class, The game is essentially Asteroids, but with Lemmings, and I think it is a nice touch to have different enemies to shoot

The Game itself has been modified from Amigoids, which uses the Amiga IFF File Format, which has been modified, along with the Sound files, to create this masterpeice, The Sound Effects are Brilliant and so is the Gameplay too, Well worth a play this one, I think you will like it

212471.overview: A maze and crosshairs shooter game created for the "Posadas Party III" event in 2018. An Amiga game developed by S2N. Escape from the labyrinth before the Batmanu attack. Batmanu has locked you inside a PC. A labyrinth of evil circuits. You will have to escape through the only door there is. Run! But beware of Batmanu! It will not make it easy.

212472.overview: This is "Lance A. Lot" released back in 1995 by Gordon Smith as a public domain/freeware game. It is a well done Joust clone, with good controls and gameplay. No pterodactyl to be found in this one but well worth a play.

212493.overview: A Bomberman clone coded in pure ASM code including teleportations, bomb freezing, bomb pushing, bomb movement energy handling, end of level board reducing, pipes for all explosions.

212494.overview:
Set on September 11, 2027, the problem: mankind's many space voyages between Earth and Mars awoke something from under the surface of the red planet. Large, primitive demons have been sighted arsing from the planet's surface, killing astronauts and destroying most of the space station complex based on planet Mars. The existence of this alien race was kept top secret until December 6, 2026 when one demon appeared in Paris France. Fatalities: 166  
 
Steadily over the past months at exactly 00:01 each night various types of these "Martians" have arisen from under the ground all around the Earth. Demons rising in populated areas act instinctively, killing people. Others rising in deserts, jungles and even under water will work with other demons in the building of unknown alien structures. The world's armed forces have killed over a thousand of the demons, but with the seemingly endless supply of the enemy, it feels like we are fighting a losing battle.  
 
The only solution is that the enemy supply must be stopped at the source. You are chosen for the mission to the demon's planet.  
 
This is a Doom-esque, overhead view shooter. Find weapons upgrades and take the fight to them!

212495.overview:
Lords & Empires is a strategy game for a fantasy world for 2 to 4 players. The game is divided into summer and winter seasons. In the summer you move your armies and conquer new land. During this process you will most likely do battle with your foes as well as with the local people unwilling to see you confiscating their land. In the winter you rearrange your forces, which means recruiting new soldiers, giving them subsistence and organizing them into armies. You can also build ships and fortresses, do some diplomacy and fulfill mode goals. 

The game has two modes, which are:

-   Conquest Mode: you can only win by defeating all other players.
-   Quest mode: Defeat all other players or gather the three artifacts, complete the quest and vanquish any artifact guardians.

212722.overview: This single screen 2D puzzler's game design by Neszt Tibor (Eddy); game ideas by Neszt Tibor (Eddy), Pallagi János (Enigma), Krasznai Szabolcs (Fred), Székely Viktor (Jimy) and Steve Holex. Coding by Neszt Tibor (Eddy). Graphics by Pallagi János (Enigma), Krasznai Szabolcs (Fred) and Székely Viktor (Jimy); sprites by Steve Holex. Sound samples by Székely Viktor (Jimy). The full version of the game has 60 playable and practice puzzle levels, many new tunes, level editor and saved functionality. Move the stones to the exit marked by an X. Blue stones are standard, red moves other stones and green are teleport stones. Move fast, time is running out.

212723.overview: A Tetris clone for one or two people created by Andy Hook of Canada and released along with source code to public domain with an intent towards instruction and collaboration with others.

212725.overview: Appeared on Zero Coverdisk 14 (Issue 21, Aug 91). In the game you control a pre-defined wizard called Merlin in a specially designed scenario. You must escape from Zol's prison using the spells at your disposal.

212803.overview: A two player Connect 4 in 3D board game based on the C64 version with updated everything by Muffbusters coder Péter Mutschler. It was released on the Hungry for Fun compilation.

212807.overview: A fan made game, written in AMOS, that pretends to be DMA Design / Psygnosis production (and from being released 2 years prior). In this game your task is to guide only one lemming to the exit.

214121.overview: A timed labyrinth game, where the player must remove all tiles on the screen before the time runs out. The game offers a total of 102 levels, after each completed stage player receives a password. The game was released as part of the Meander game pack in Poland, all games in the pack appear to be coded by Artur Hałaczkiewicz aka mandarin.

214122.overview: Labyrinth is a port of a Commodore 64 game published by Commodore in 1983 (not to be confused with the 1986 film adaptation from LucasFilm), which was itself a souped-up version of an earlier public domain game originally written in BASIC for the Commodore PET. You start off with a top level view of the map for a short time, then you must navigate out of the maze in first person view. Try to escape the maze in as few moves as possible.

214123.overview: A collect'em up game by the fruitful game maker, Harald Müller (Mueller) that was released in Gamers' Delight and Gamers' Delight 2 in 1994. It has 20 levels and then loops with increased enemy speed.

214124.overview:
The game consists of 64 individually named levels, the task of each of which is to collect a certain amount of red and green gems and get to the exit, while avoiding the rampant spiders that inhabit the levels.

To guide your man around the screen, use the joystick or the cursor keys. You can dig through ground and collect gems and keys by simply moving towards them.

The spiders move all the time, trying to home in on you. They move slower on earlier levels, but fasten on later levels. Needless to say, contact with the spiders is fatal.

For your defence, you have bombs. Each level gives you a certain amount of bombs. To drop a bomb, press fire or return. It will detonate shortly after it has been dropped. On some levels you may not have bombs at all.

There are two kinds of wall, one which can be bombed through and one which can not. It's up to you to find out which is which.

There also are teleports, keys and locks. The teleports look like purple blobs. If you use a teleport, you are teleported randomly somewhere on the screen. Take care, the spiders can also use the teleports!

To collect a key, move to it. Moving to a lock carrying a key opens the lock and decreases your key amount by one.

When you have collected the required amount of gems, find the exit and move to it. But you must note that you must collect the exact amount of gems required! If you collect too many gems, you won't be qualified to the next
level. To help you out on this, you can leave gems behind by pressing del or help.

Every level has a fixed amount of moves within which you must complete it. If you run out of moves, you die, but are granted a new set of moves.

214125.overview: Tired of games that don't use the Amiga's superior sound and graphics capabilities? Do you ever get the feeling that your Amiga has been transformed into a bit Atari ST emulator? Now is your chance to strike back. Blast as many ST's and aliens as possible. Blast your way from the 520 level up to the Mega level and beyond... good luck! Released on the coverdisk of CU Amiga May 1990. The intro music consists of a sampled part of the Queen song "Another One Bites The Dust", taken from their 1980 album "The Game".

214126.overview: A variation on the Artillery duel game by Fatima Productions and released in 1993.

214127.overview: A Tetris variant by Fredrik Lidbert released in a type of freeware where you just had to send an email or a postcart to fully own the product, but no limit to distribution. It is a fast paced Testris variant with good music.

214128.overview: Legend of the Exploding Fist is a fighting game based on the C64 original. It features up to five karatekas in one fight, has a variety of backgrounds and locations and has a pleasant focus on the defensive game that other, similar games miss.

214134.overview: A simple Snake\Worm\Tron game for up to 4 players, from A Argentieri, released to PD in 1993.

214135.overview: Light Cycles with new features. This game, created by Chris Underwood and released in 1996 is a 2 to 4 player game where there are powerups like speed mines, fences and other differences like the ability to go on  diagonals, and use shields added to the normal Worm type game. Create your own levels with IFF picture import for backgrounds.

214137.overview:
The very first multiplayer game made in the Scorpion Engine. Adapt to seasonal changes as you battle in this 48 hour Kiwijam game.

Two players required.

* Race to collect the season changing orbs, or
* Push each other off the screen repeatedly.

214138.overview: In  Litterbusters: The Game you have to collect all the litter from the streets of 5 towns. To do this you pick up the cans, bottles or newspapers scattered around. You can only reach the bus stop where they are all collected. Sometimes doors need to be opened. To do this you have to hold all the keys. Also, to walk over a rubbish tip you need a bag to put the rubbish in. There are three types of invisible objects: walls, man-holes (which kill you) and extra lives.

214139.overview:
Released on Power-Disc 4, this puzzler by Michael Baumgaertner was published by Markt & Technik in 1991, but the game is marked 1990 indicating it may have been released elsewhere beforehand. The game can be played with 2 human players, against the computer or you can allow the computer to play itself to review technique. 
 
Published in Issue 4 of the Amiga Power magazine in August 1991 on the included Amiga Power Disk 4.

214148.overview: A puzzler created by Tobias Drecksack, Chris Hülsbeck (Huelsbeck), Sascha Krammig and Tobias Drecksack of Legend and released in Amigo! Issue 5/92 and in Amiga Fun (DE), Issue 6/94.

214149.overview: A conversion of an MSX game to the A500 by hitchhiker, where the aim of the game is to avoid falling rain. Game comes with source code.

214151.overview: The game's title "Łowca: Ostatnie Starcie" translates as "Hunter: Final Conflict". Based on the 1993 film Lowca. Łowca: Ostatnie Starcie is a game loosely based on the Polish movie of the same name. It starts when Thorn and Gaeth kidnap Janik. As a son of Janik the player must finish four mini-games to save his parent. The first stage is a street car race, where the player must avoid collisions with other cars and numerous obstacles such as holes, pools or oil stains. Each collision causes damage to the car, shown through a percentage indicator. The second stage is a platform game. The player must find three items hidden in five rooms before time runs out, avoiding Thorn and Gaeth. In the third stage the player returns to the road, this time driving a motorbike. The same rules apply, but the goal is not only safe driving - the player must catch up with the kidnappers. The last stage takes place in the underground metro. The player must collect all the letters of the password required to disarm the bomb before time runs out.

214175.overview:
Move Lumberjack left and right of the tree to chop wood making sure to avoid the deadly branches. The game is also over when the timer expires. -High heels: Slows down energy loss, 
-Panties: Recharges energy
-Bra: Gives 25 points
-Collect 3 different items to turn on Switch Mode. Switching sides gives 10 points.
-Beer bottle: Shakes your screen thus slowing you down a bit while you chop for a while. Ends switch Switch Mode.
In the options menu, if you chose Hard difficulty, picking up the beer bottle will reverse your controls for a while.

214176.overview: You're a lumberjack and you're way more than just OK! You're so amazing that you cut out chunks as you chop them, but as there are branches on both sides you always need to hit the tree from the correct side and avoid the branches, too much beer and switching sides completely by avoiding silky smooth ladies undies that might distract you from Lumberjacking and seduce you into LumberJilling. That's an entirely different game.

214177.overview: Lupengo a simple arcade-like, Pengo style game, yet completely Penguin free and freely available in GPL. Lupengo for Amiga is a full-featured arcade-like game, that I started writing in 1987; I never had time to make it commercial quality, so I am releasing now as free software. This also means that whoever wants to take over this project is free to do so. Ironically this non-penguin game is also available for Linux.

214786.overview: Bridge Player Galactica is a Bridge card game with betting elements, developed and published by Oxford Softworks, which was released in Europe in 1989. Game written in HiSoft BASIC. Original coding by Richard Wheen and Nicola Gardener; Amiga conversion by Ian Stirzaker and Chris Whittington.

214936.overview: Laberinto is a single player action game by Sensei-Sama (aka Pozo) & Zener. This is like the old school wooden maze and metal ball game you may have played in childhood, intended to improve fine motor skills. In this one you must maneuver the ball around all the holes to the checkered flag.

214972.overview:
The sudden and unexpected return of evil swept the land like a hurricane. The unprepared armies tried their best to defend the kingdom but could not drive back the up rush, thus forcing the king to withdraw the remainder to the defense of a handful of castles. As the main part of the army was destroyed within the first days all castles are practically defenseless. So it was proclaimed that the man who succeeds in repulsing the evil up rush may win the hand of princess Kana and inherit the throne. You take a chance.

The Last Refuge is a freeware Space Invaders clone for the Amiga, distributed on disk 728 of the Fred Fish collection. As a knight, the player has to fend off an invading army and protect the castle walls. One variation to the formula is the addition of power-ups hidden inside chests. These are marked with a symbol to differentiate each type:

- The weapons chests have a red symbol, and come with a single shot, double shot, light beam, bombs, guided shot and "unknown" power-ups.

- There is a brown symbol on the spell chests. They contain slow/speed, weaken/strengthen, kill all visible and "unknown" spells.

- The extras chests have a black symbol. They come with stop time, protection, shield, super shot, "unknown" and extra life power-ups.

215091.overview:
Formerly, in the world of Sortilia, there was a Stone of Power, entrusted to the Supreme Mage. But one day a demonic being called Xanthior took hold of this stone of power. This stone gives its owner much heightened magical powers, which Xanthior used to his advantage. Sortilia quickly sank into terror... Horedes of monsters, each more terrifying than the next, devastated the whole country. The mage was imprisoned by Xanthior in the dungeons of his terrifying fortress. 
 
The only way to defeat this evil being was to destroy it and the Power Stone. Only the mage knew how to defeat him. It was therefore necessary to free him and annihilate Xanthior.

215109.overview: It's dungeon crawler very similar in gameplay to Might and Magic series with some influences of Black Crypt. Use your weapons, spells and wit to defeat your villainous foes. In Legacy you have the opportunity to explore huge map areas each of which contain doorways to additional maps that are made up of multi-level towers or dungeons as well as swamps & forests. Three of these primary areas contain cities in which you can find places to rest and recruit party members as well as places to buy and sell items.

215151.overview: A Sokoban style 2D puzzler created in AMOS by Bohewia Software and released in Amiga Future. Written in AMOS Professional. Coding by Bohewia Software. Graphics by Karel Scholberk. Music by David Koudelka. Magazine Publisher: Amiga Future no. 123, Nov/Dec 2016

215240.overview:
Liga Polska Manager '96 is a sports management game, developed by Group M and published by Marksoft, which was released in Europe in 1995. Liga Polska Manager 96 is an updated and expanded football management game for 1996. The game allows the player to select a team, manage and promote it and gather the players and coaches for success in this competitive league sport.  The second game in MarkSoft's Liga Polska Manager series of football management games. You start off managing a team in first or second Polish league. The game covers national backyard and European cups. The game has all the typical options for managers in the mid 90s. The features include the sale and rental of the players, setting the salary, advertising, television rights, type of transportation, accommodation, bonuses, ticket prices, a full set of statistics and graphs, training, tactics, expansion of the stadium and others.

All players are described by: technique, speed, passing, shooting. During the match, all the interesting situations are presented in the form of isometric video animation.

215242.overview: Liga Polska is a Polish language football management game. The game allows the player to select one team of a fifty two available. The player may choose start year, although the game begins always in the second league stage. The game covers national backyard and European cups. The player as a manager decides on sponsors and ticket prize, footballers transfers, stadium facilities, composition of the team, planning tactics for each match and intensity of training. During the match all the interesting situations are presented in the form of isometric video animation. There is no match commentary included.
